title: How Drinks Network Courses Work
description: A two-lesson walkthrough of how our courses run: review, listen, answer, then move on.

lessons.title: Review, listen, answer
lessons.review:
Every Drinks Network course is broken into short lessons, and every lesson has the same three steps.

1. Review. Read through the lesson first. Take your time; you can come back to it at any point.

2. Listen. Then listen to the lesson. Where there's a recording or video you'll play that; otherwise the lesson is read aloud to you. Listen to the end to unlock the questions.

3. Answer. Finally, answer a few questions about what you've just learned. Get at least 80% right and the next lesson unlocks. If you miss the mark, have another look and try again.

Your progress is saved in this browser, so you can stop and pick up where you left off.

options: At least 80% of the questions right

lessons.title: What you can learn with us
lessons.review:
Our courses cover the biggest-selling categories in liquor, so you can step up your game behind the bar, in the bottle shop or on the road as a rep.

Courses include Rice Spirits Explained, Rice Wine Explained, Whisky Explained, Bourbon Explained and Tequila Explained.

They're written for bartenders, retailers and curious drinkers, and they're a great foundation if you're joining RepShare as a producer.

Use the code LEARNDRINKS to take them for free.
